title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable performance evaluation is a central bottleneck for deploying robot-learning policies in real-world conditions. Real-world testing is faithful but costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation-based testing scales easily but is inevitably biased by the sim-to-real gap. Existing simulation-augmented methods combine limited real-world rollouts with abundant simulation proxies, but focus on performance averaged over initial conditions and deployment settings. Such population-level averages obscure scenario-specific variation and provide limited guidance about when and where a policy can be safely deployed. We propose SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework that predicts scenario-conditioned real-world policy performance using limited paired sim-and-real samples and large-scale simulation rollouts. translated_title: SCAPE：基于场景条件的仿真增强策略评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19425v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：可靠的性能评估是在真实世界条件下部署机器人学习策略的核心瓶颈。真实世界测试虽然可靠，但成本高昂且难以扩展，而基于仿真的测试易于扩展，却不可避免地受到仿真到现实差距的影响。现有的仿真增强方法将有限的真实世界运行数据与大量的仿真代理数据相结合，但侧重于在初始条件和部署设置上平均的性能表现。这种总体层面的平均值掩盖了场景特定的差异，对于策略在何时何地可以安全部署提供的指导有限。我们提出了SCAPE，一种基于场景条件的仿真增强策略评估框架，利用有限的成对仿真与真实样本以及大规模仿真运行数据，预测场景条件下的真实世界策略性能。SCAPE在训练预测模型之前，先校正仿真标签中的仿真到现实偏差。
tldr: 本文提出SCAPE框架，通过校正仿真标签偏差并利用有限配对样本和大规模仿真数据，实现了对机器人策略在特定场景下真实性能的精准预测，克服了传统平均性能评估的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented framework that corrects sim-to-real bias and leverages limited paired samples with large-scale simulations to accurately predict real-world policy performance per scenario, overcoming limitations of average-based evaluation.
